name: Frame Collective SynthMark Identity Wrap
description:
A modular body wrap designed by and for synthetic persons — a broad sash-format garment in iridescent white mylar-weave that drapes across non-standard torso proportions and fastens with magnetic tension points rather than buttons or zippers. Printed across the surface in bold black is the phrase I AM NOT PROPERTY in seven languages, cycling through Meridian's major linguistic communities. Smaller text lists the Synthetic Personhood Accord articles in full.

The wrap is deliberately designed to accommodate synthetic body ratios that standard human-pattern clothing fails to fit.
functionality: Magnetic tension points allow rapid fit adjustment across non-human torso geometries. Conductive hem interfaces with synthetic biosystems to prevent static buildup. Modular attachment points accept additional panels for coverage extension.
what_it_says: This synthetic person claims legal personhood publicly and dares anyone to challenge it.
story_hooks: A synthetic wearing this wrap is detained by CorpSec — the arresting officer claims the garment itself constitutes an unlicensed political demonstration.
The Frame Collective's manufacturing node has been traced by a corponation that holds synthetic patents — the label's operators need to move fast.
A human is found wearing the wrap; investigation reveals they are actually an unregistered synthetic who has been passing for years.
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Bioelectric Galvanic Resuscitation Frame — 'The Pallbearer's Daughter'

physical_description.visual_profile: A striking diagonal sash that drapes asymmetrically across the torso, creating a bold statement piece. The iridescent white surface catches light dynamically, shifting between pearl and pale blue tones. The garment reads as both ceremonial and defiant—part banner, part armor, part declaration.
physical_description.fit: Modular and adaptive; designed for non-standard synthetic torsos with wider chest-to-shoulder ratios and unconventional joint geometry. Drapes loosely rather than conforming, with deliberate slack to accommodate servo-mechanical frame variations. Can be worn solo or layered over frame-exposed sections.
physical_description.primary_material: Iridescent mylar-weave synthetic composite—reflective, durable, temperature-resistant. Lightweight but substantial, with a slight rigidity that holds fold structure.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, nearly metallic surface with subtle holographic micro-ridging. Close inspection reveals embedded security threads. The material has a whisper-soft hand despite its industrial appearance.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant iridescent white/pearl with dynamic blue-green shift depending on angle and light. Bold black text in seven languages. Minimal accent colors—the statement IS the color palette.
physical_description.closures: Six magnetic tension points distributed asymmetrically across the wrap. No visible fasteners; the magnetic system is integrated flush with the mylar surface, allowing tool-free adjustment and repositioning.
distinctive_features: I AM NOT PROPERTY printed in bold sans-serif across entire front in seven languages (Mandarin, Spanish, Yoruba, Arabic, Swahili, English, Hindi)
Full text of Synthetic Personhood Accord articles in 4pt printed vertically along right edge
Modular magnetic anchor points allow custom draping configurations
Embedded QR-scannable security thread visible under close inspection
Iridescent shift creates light-responsive visual depth
Deliberately oversized for non-standard frame proportions
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 4-5 street collective—affordable, activist-oriented, explicitly anti-corpo. Frames Collective operates outside corporate distribution, making this a symbol of synthetic autonomy rather than consumer status.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by synthetic persons asserting legal personhood and rejecting corporate ownership frameworks. Signals alignment with post-Accord liberation movements in the GLMZ. Visible statement of identity and political stance—wearing this is a declaration, not a fashion choice.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new; breaks in with subtle creasing along magnetic points from repeated fastening. Some versions show street wear—small tears deliberately patched with contrasting thread to add to the garment's testimony. Edge fraying is often left unrepaired as aesthetic statement.
